title: Classical CFD validation cases against their published tables
description: The lid-driven cavity of Ghia, Ghia and Shin (1982), the backward-facing step of Armaly et al. (1983), the NASA TMR flat plate, a surrogate warm start and a low-fidelity ladder: each case is written as an OpenFOAM case, solved on a ladder of meshes and compared with the published table or, where the table is not transcribed, with itself and with an independent law. The numbers are in classical_cases/README.md and in classical_cases/results/*.json.
methods: proper orthogonal decomposition over Reynolds number

metrics.name: cavity_u_l2_relative_re100_128
metrics.how: L2 of the measured u profile against Ghia (1982) Table I at 17 stations, over the RMS of the table, wall stations excluded; OpenFOAM v2606 simpleFoam, 128x128, residual 1e-6

metrics.name: cavity_observed_order_re1000
metrics.how: Richardson extrapolation (Roache GCI) over the measured profiles at 32, 64 and 128 cells per side, refinement ratio 2

metrics.name: cavity_gci_fine_re1000
metrics.how: GCI of the 128x128 mesh from the same three-mesh study, safety factor 1.25

metrics.name: step_x1_over_S_re400_32
metrics.how: reattachment length of the backward-facing step at Re = 400 from the sign change of the first-cell-row velocity, 32 cells per step height

metrics.name: step_convergence_16_to_32_re200
metrics.how: relative change of x1/S from 16 to 32 cells per step height at Re = 200

metrics.name: tmr_cf_extrapolated_spalart_allmaras
metrics.how: Richardson-extrapolated skin friction at x = 0.97 on the NASA TMR flat plate, Re = 5e6, three grids refined by two, wallShearStress function object

metrics.name: tmr_cf_extrapolated_komega_sst
metrics.how: the same extrapolation with kOmegaSST; the 1/7-power law at the station is 0.002994

metrics.name: tmr_observed_order_spalart_allmaras
metrics.how: apparent order of accuracy from the three grid levels

metrics.name: warm_start_speedup_re400
metrics.how: wall time of the cold cavity run over the warm one at Re = 400, which the POD surrogate was not fitted on

metrics.name: warm_start_speedup_re1000
metrics.how: same ratio at Re = 1000; the converged fields differ by 6.3e-4 relative in U

metrics.name: ladder_spearman_cl_thin_airfoil
metrics.how: Spearman rank correlation of the three NACA 0012 designs by CL between the closed-form rung and the finest RANS level

metrics.name: ladder_seconds_per_design_rans_fine
metrics.how: wall time of one RANS level at the fine resolution, simpleFoam kOmegaSST at Re = 4e6

metrics.name: ladder_cl_error_abs_thin_airfoil
metrics.how: mean absolute CL difference of thin-airfoil theory against the finest RANS level over NACA 0012 at alpha = 0, 4, 8 deg, Re = 4e6

metrics.name: ladder_cl_error_abs_rans_coarse
metrics.how: the same difference for the coarse RANS level (2624 cells, 20.3 s per design)

checks.name: the transcribed tables are internally consistent (lid at u = 1, walls at rest, one centreline crossing)
a coarse cavity at Re = 100 agrees with Ghia to 2 % in u and 5 % in v
refining the cavity mesh reduces the error against the table at Re = 400 and 1000
the step reattaches and the length is converged to 1 % between the two finest meshes
both turbulence models converge on the TMR plate with a GCI below 1 %
a warm start saves iterations and converges to the same field as a cold start
one transcribed station of the Re = 400 v column disagrees with the converged run and is recorded, not corrected

references: Ghia, Ghia and Shin (1982), J. Comput. Phys. 48(3), 387-411
Armaly et al. (1983), J. Fluid Mech. 127, 473-496
de Vahl Davis (1983), Int. J. Numer. Methods Fluids 3(3), 249-264
